mutant.original: (a, b) => this.who[a]! - this.who[b]! || this.at[a]! - this.at[b]! || a - b
mutant.lineText: rows.sort((a, b) => this.who[a]! - this.who[b]! || this.at[a]! - this.at[b]! || a - b);
mutant.prevText: for (let i = 0; i < this.length; i++) if (!names || names.has(this.name[i]!)) rows.push(i);
